note: The Indonesia campaign page https://www.specialoffers.jcb/id/campaign/d/southeast-and-south-asia/indonesia/ loads its tiles from this public JSON file (20 entries on 25 Nov 2026). The English campaign file lists only 3 multi-region campaigns, and none is for Indonesia-issued cards alone. Each entry is one campaign page /id/campaign/detail/<name>/<id>/. Read each page by hand when it changes: the page text is free text, one page can hold several deals (Trip.com has four promo codes, ANA a discount and a cashback, Singapore Airlines two cashbacks), and the eligible cards are named in the text (Indonesia-issued cards, issuer names, or the Ultimate and Precious tiers). The roundup 'Eksklusif Dining di Jakarta & Bali' (89804) repeats restaurants that have their own offer pages; only Morimoto is handed in from it.
